_doc: Framework §2.4 curated lists, verbatim (no additions). K=+2: Pacific/Indian Ocean microstates and remote dependencies; K=+1: the framework's named low-profile non-European <5M countries. Countries not listed = 0. 'regions' covers +2 remote dependencies whose locations carry a parent country (United Kingdom). Candidates NOT added pending review: Bhutan, Maldives, Guyana, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Belize, Fiji.
